claim: ANK2 is an exome-wide significant rare-variant risk gene for ADHD identified via combined iPSYCH+gnomAD rare-coding burden testing.
value: P(final) combined class I+II meta-analysis = 2.27307199679582e-06; OR(combined class I c1) = 5.54769260336939; pLI = 1.0. Main text abstract reports P = 2.72e-6 (discrepancy with exact ST4 value).
source: Demontis et al. 2025 (Nature 649): main text + Supplementary Table 4
source_table: Supplementary Table 4 (Top 20 ADHD rare-variant risk genes)
notes: Exact ST4 P(final) = 2.273e-06; main text displays P=2.72e-06. Preserve exact ST4 value; discrepancy documented in docs/decisions.md. ST4 also reports pLI=1.0; 16/20 top genes are constrained.
quantitative_metric: P(final) combined class I+II gene burden

claim: ANK2 rare-variant burden is driven by class I variants (rPTVs: protein-truncating variants)
value: 11 iPSYCH ADHD cases / 12 combined controls (iPSYCH+gnomAD); P(combined c1) = 1.2035297803548e-04; OR(combined c1) = 5.54769260336939.
source: Demontis 2025: main text states ANK2 signal derived from both class I and class II; exact counts/Ps from ST4
notes: Class I (rPTV) drives ANK2 association; MAP1A and ANO8 were driven entirely by class I only. OR~5.5 for rare PTV in constrained gene (pLI=1).

claim: ANK2 rare-variant burden is also driven by class II variants (rModerateDMVs: moderately damaging missense variants)
value: 3 iPSYCH ADHD cases / 0 combined controls; P(combined c2) = 0.00285778222177253; OR(combined c2) = Inf (zero control carriers).
source: Demontis 2025: main text explicitly distinguishes ANK2 from MAP1A/ANO8 (class I only); ST4 provides counts/P/OR.
notes: Zero control carriers → OR = Inf. This mixed class I+class II architecture is unique to ANK2 among the three genes.

claim: ANK2 is a known rare-variant risk gene for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and broader neurodevelopmental disorders (NDD).
source: Demontis 2025: ST4 FDR flags + main text Results/Discussion: 'consistent with ANK2 being a known rare-variant risk gene in autism'; '9 [of top-20 ADHD genes] have been implicated with autism and/or other neurodevelopmental disorders (FDR < 5%)'
notes: Classified as 'genetic' (not phenotype): the ST4 ASD_FDR0.05/NDD_FDR0.05 flags record gene-level membership of ANK2 in published ASD and NDD rare-variant risk-gene lists (binary FDR<0.05 membership from prior exome-sequencing studies); they are gene-level cross-disorder genetic annotation, not a carrier-phenotype observation (carrier phenotypes are AD-05/AD-06). Not an independent discovery of this study.

claim: The ADHD rare-variant ANK2 signal was driven mainly by individuals with ADHD plus co-occurring autism or intellectual disability (ID), consistent with ANK2 being a known ASD risk gene.
value: Qualitative statement; no exact proportion reported in the accessible text.
notes: Exact proportion not provided in accessible main text or Supplementary Information; directional claim only.

claim: Among individuals carrying rare class I variants in ANK2, phenotype breakdown shows majority ADHD-only, with a minority having ADHD+ID or ADHD+ASD+SZ+ID.
value: Total ANK2 class I carriers = 11: 1 control (0_0_0_0); 7 ADHD-only (1_0_0_0); 2 ADHD+ID (1_0_0_1); 1 ADHD+ASD+SZ+ID (1_1_1_1).
source: Demontis 2025: Supplementary Information (Phenotype of individuals with class I variants), Supplementary Figure 5
notes: Counts read directly from figure bars and labels; the phenotype partition is a visual estimate from Supplementary Figure 5, not a reported statistic in the text, so confidence downgraded to low. Among the 11 ANK2 class I carriers shown in Supp Fig. 5, 3 had ASD/SZ/ID comorbidity. AD-05 states signal 'driven mainly by ADHD+ASD/ID' at the statistical level; this figure shows carrier phenotype counts.
quantitative_value: 11 carriers total (1 control + 7 ADHD-only + 2 ADHD+ID + 1 ADHD+ASD+SZ+ID)

claim: Top 20 ADHD rare-variant risk genes are enriched for the DisGeNET 'Channelopathies' gene set; ANK2 is among the overlapping genes.
value: 4/55 genes overlap; raw P = 2.40E-07; corrected P = 2.43E-04; overlapping genes: UBE2S; KCNA2; ANK2; CACNA1D.
source: Demontis 2025: Supplementary Table 11 (Enrichment analyses: Top 20 ADHD risk genes, Channelopathies row)
source_section: Results (Linking ADHD risk genes to biology)
notes: Classified as 'genetic' (not PPI): ST11 row 4 has INPUT gene set = 'Top 20 ADHD rare variant risk genes' (the ADHD rare-variant gene-discovery set), NOT the ANK2 PPI network; the ANK2 PPI-union enrichments are separate ST11 rows ('ANK2 Union'). Main text: 'the top 20 ADHD risk genes were enriched ... among genes involved in channelopathies (P = 2.4 × 10−7)', interpreted as neuronal synaptic channelopathies being involved in ADHD. ANK2 is one of 4 overlapping members.
quantitative_metric: corrected enrichment P (top 20 ADHD risk genes in Channelopathies)

source: Demontis 2025: Supplementary Table 11 (ANK2 Union GO enrichment rows); main text (reports corrected P = 2.77e-39)
source_section: Results (Linking ADHD risk genes to biology)
notes: Union = NPC+ExN combined network. Corrected P matches protocol §5 value exactly.

value: 70/158 ANK2 union genes (44.30%) mapped to SynGO synaptic annotations; GO:0045202 synapse: 67/1478; raw P = 8.44552848844588e-31; corrected P = 1.5201951279202584e-29.
source: Demontis 2025: Supplementary Table 11 (SynGO section: ANK2 Union GO:0045202); main text (reports 44.30%)
source_section: Results (Linking ADHD risk genes to biology)

claim: ANK2 PPI-union network is enriched for rare-variant risk genes of ASD and developmental disorders (DD), indicating overlap of ANK2 interactome with NDD-associated genes.
value: ASD enrichment: NetCount=140 / BackCount=12003; KS P = 7.92597452559107e-07; FDR = 1.90223388614186e-06. DD enrichment: P = 1e-15; FDR = 7.61295788314393e-16.
source: Demontis 2025: PPI Supplementary Table 8 (Rare_Variant); Rows ANK2_Union (ASD, DD)
notes: One-tailed KS tests comparing ANK2 union genes to neuronal background gene bodies; direction = greater. Network derived from published IP-MS data (not generated de novo in Demontis 2025).
